summary: Woori Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a record date (May 6, 2026) for a comprehensive share exchange with TONGYANG Life Insurance Co., Ltd., proceeding as a small-scale share exchange under Korean law. The filing does not disclose price, premium, or advisor. Shareholders may oppose; if holders of >20% of shares object, a shareholder meeting is required. The exchange follows ordinary procedures of the Korean Commercial Code. Watch for shareholder opposition threshold and regulatory timeline; risk-arb hinge on approval mechanics and potential appraisal rights.
